title: Count of partially interpolated polynomials
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ have finite subsets $t\subseteq s$, let $v:\iota\to F$ be injective on $s$, and let $w:\iota\to F$. The number of polynomials $p\in F[X]$ of degree less than $|s|$ satisfying $p(v(i))=w(i)$ for every $i\in t$ is $|F|^{|s|-|t|}$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ and $s$ are finite subsets of $\iota$ with $t\subseteq s$
